ignoreCommand: [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" != "main" ] && exit 0; [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . ../../packages ../../package.json ../../package-lock.json ../../tsconfig.json ../../.npmrc && exit 0; exit 1
